name: The Crust King
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A crawler grown huge under a crown of yellow sulphur crust, on the crust fields by the shore. It snaps (cone), fires crust shards in a cross, and burrows to come up under every player at once. At 60% it shakes its crown loose: crust falls in chunks that leave armour-eating sulphur behind, and it breathes a wide cone of brimstone. At 30% its subjects swarm out of the crust.
party: Open world elite. Solo: tough — the burrow and the crust both stack up. 2-3: intended. 5+: quick. M5 scaling: health by players tagged; crawlers 3 -> 4 at five; crust chunks +1 per extra player.

pull: The crust field cracks. Something crowned and many-legged climbs out.
The Crust King raises its claws. Its little subjects chitter.
say.death: The Crust King topples. Its crown breaks into yellow dust.
say.reset: The Crust King scrapes back under its crust.

shards.name: Crust Shards
shards.say: Crust shards fly out four ways!

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.say: The Crust King digs in — it is coming up under everyone!

crown_fall.name: Crown Fall
crown_fall.say: Chunks of crown crust come crashing down!

brimstone.name: Brimstone Breath
brimstone.say: It breathes brimstone — get out of the front!

phases.name: Shedding the Crown
phases.say: The Crust King shakes its crown loose!

phases.name: Subjects!
phases.say: Its subjects pour out of the crust to defend it!
